ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low ratio; approximately 15:85 white-to-black pixel intensity distribution across the macro-level fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant low-intensity black background with high-intensity white linear and circular clusters dispersed across both lobes. Distinct high-contrast white pixel clusters are concentrated at the extreme distal lateral tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped central depression with a calculated angle of approximately 35 degrees and a high depth-to-width bounding box ratio.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern detected along the continuous trailing edge; characterized by numerous jagged pixel-level peaks and valleys ranging from the notch to the lateral tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curve fitted to the inner trailing edges of both lobes, transitioning to a slight convex sweep as the contour approaches the lateral points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple small-scale, roughly circular high-intensity pixel clusters distributed across the fluke surface; significant high-density clusters are located at the lateral terminal edges.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of white, non-aligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) of varying orientations and lengths observed across the medial and lateral regions of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Pervasive white scarring across the ventral surface consisting of a mix of linear abrasions and circular rosette patterns, indicative of significant historical trauma or barnacle colonization.
other_distinctive_markers: Dense, textured white pixel accumulation at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes, distinct from the smoother pigmentation and scarring observed on the main lobe bodies.
